_comment: Channel registry for orchestrate.py. Adding, disabling or re-pointing a channel is a change HERE, never in the code. Every model that rotates lives in this file so there is exactly one place to edit when a weekly limit runs out. Aliases are what a natural-language override like '5.5 instead of 5.6 Sol' is matched against; they must be unique across the whole file - routing.py refuses to load a registry with a colliding alias rather than guessing.

spark.label: Spark (Messages API)
spark.notes: Default for lookups and fact-checks. Content filter is cumulative - probe cheap first.

codex.label: Codex CLI
codex.notes: Strategic questions and final line-level audits only. Never send it a lookup.

agy.label: Antigravity CLI (Gemini)
agy._model_form: Base slugs only, never the -high/-low suffixed form. Suffix and --effort are two spellings of one setting and a disagreement is a HARD failure: '--model gemini-3.1-pro-high --effort low' exits 1 in 3 seconds with 'conflicts with --effort=low'. With a base slug, --effort is the single source of truth. 'efforts' below is not decoration: gemini-3.1-pro genuinely has no medium, and asking for one is the same hard failure.
agy._models_removed: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6-thinking and gemini-3.1-pro-low are deliberately absent (the operator, 2026-07-31): routing a Claude model through agy spends the Gemini weekly subscription on a model already reachable directly, and Pro Low is the shallow variant this channel exists to avoid.
agy.notes: Reports no tool telemetry in text mode - always run it through stream-json and count the tool calls.
